summary: RETEST of iter6 HIGH security finding (brute-force lockout bypass behind k8s ingress). The fix in /app/backend/server.py login() now derives client IP from X-Forwarded-For (first entry) -> X-Real-IP -> request.client.host, AND adds a second limiter keyed by email alone (threshold 10) on top of the per-IP+email limiter (threshold 5), both locking for 15 minutes and clearing on successful login. Updated test_brute_force_lockout_public_rca to assert the 6th response is 429 via the PUBLIC URL. Full re-run of /app/backend/tests/test_security_hardening.py: 14/14 PASS. Regression items from iter6 (order PII redaction for anon/other-user, full for owner/admin, /api/my/orders scoped by user_id, demo approve, CORS) all still pass.

verification_details.brute_force_public_fixed: POST /api/auth/login x6 with wrong password for retest-brute-*@test.com via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL returned [401,401,401,401,401,429]. Previously (iter6) stayed 401x6 due to request.client.host round-robining across ingress pod IPs.
verification_details.valid_login_unaffected: cliente@test.com/Cliente123! and camila@archivelab.design/Archive2026! both return 200 with correct role; successful login clears both counters.
verification_details.order_pii_redaction: GET /api/orders/{id} anon/non-owner returns only {id,status,kind,total,currency,items[name,unit_code,size,edition_number]} — no guest_email/guest_name/shipping_address/payment. Owner & admin get full order.
verification_details.my_orders_scoping: GET /api/my/orders returns only orders where user_id == me.id; guest checkout using logged user's email does NOT appear.
verification_details.demo_approve: POST /api/demo/approve/{id} still returns 200 and status becomes 'paid' in current MP_MODE=test.
verification_details.cors: Allowed origin reflected on GET; unknown origin not echoed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:566-568 — IP extraction now correctly honors X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP. If ingress ever becomes untrusted, consider restricting to a trusted proxy list, but for current single-ingress k8s this is fine.
server.py:582-589 — reset of count to 0 after setting locked_until means lock survives 15min; subsequent lock extensions require 5 (or 10) more fails — acceptable.
Minor: PytestRemovedIn10Warning for class-scoped fixtures-as-methods still present; non-blocking.
